sentences.text: `` Heartlight '' is a song written by Neil Diamond , Carole Bayer Sager and her then-husband Burt Bacharach , and recorded by Diamond in 1982 .	Neil Diamond	Neil Diamond	Heartlight	Heartlight (album)	Carole Bayer Sager	Carole Bayer Sager	Burt Bacharach	Burt Bacharach	1982	1982 in music

The song is the first track on Diamond 's 1982 album , also titled Heartlight , and reached number five on the Billboard Hot 100 , becoming his eighth -LRB- and last -RRB- top 5 hit on the chart .	Heartlight	Heartlight (album)	1982	1982 in music

The song also spent four weeks atop the adult contemporary chart in late 1982 , and was the last of his eight # 1s on that chart .	1982	1982 in music	adult contemporary chart	Adult Contemporary (chart)
The song is inspired by the blockbuster movie E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial , which Diamond , Bayer Sager and Bacharach had all seen together .	E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial	E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
When the alien E.T. leaves Earth , his heart glows a luminous red , hence the title of the song .
The songwriters were required to pay Universal Studios $ 25,000 for the use of ideas from the film .	Universal Studios	Universal Studios
